cleansingStrength.rationale: Low: C6 - no strong anionic at all; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the mild anionic Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate @2 with prominent glucoside/amphoteric co-surfactants (Decyl Glucoside @3, Cocamidopropyl Betaine @4, Coco-Glucoside @8). The unclassified Coconut Acid @12 / Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @13 are not strong anionics and cannot change C6.

conditioningLevel.rationale: High: rich architecture (W-RICH read with E3 for Section 5) - the prominent payload lipids Argan Oil @6 and Hydrogenated Castor Oil @11 converge with a prominent amino-silicone Amodimethicone @9 and cationic Guar HPTC @10, plus the prominent pearlizing route Glycol Distearate @14. C2 is not met (no listed humectant: no Glycerin/Panthenol etc.; Hexylene Glycol is a solvent), which is the counter-signal; neighbor moderate.

weightPotential.rationale: High: W-RICH with limited reset - material payload lipids (Argan Oil @6, waxy Hydrogenated Castor Oil @11) converge with Amodimethicone @9 and Guar HPTC @10, and the mild C6 taurate/glucoside/betaine chassis gives only weak reset.

unresolved: Sodium Hydrolyzed Potato Starch Dodecenylsuccinate @7 (anionic modified starch, likely emulsion stabilizer/film; no cationic charge - not counted as deposition; cannot lower the band)
Disodium Tetrapropenyl Succinate @13 (role uncertain; not a deposition family)

weightPotential.counterevidence: Argan oil sits after Sodium Chloride @5, so its amount is plausibly modest; amodimethicone and guar are single members of their families; the potato-starch succinate @7 is unresolved (not cationic).
weightPotential.whyThisBand: W-RICH (material lipids + amino-silicone + cationic guar) meets limited reset (resetCapacity weak, mild C6 chassis), which is the high anchor rich route; persistent amodimethicone and waxy hydrogenated castor oil support persistence.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: Not moderate: the moderate reading would need an effective reset (C1/C5 chassis) to offset the rich architecture, but the sulfate-free taurate/glucoside/betaine base is weak reset; the lipids are material (before the W-line @19) and not at the boundary position.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: Lipid amounts after salt are unknown; the unresolved anionic starch succinate @7 is not deposition and cannot lighten the band.
